Platinum series · SV

Supreme Victors

Released August 19, 2009 · 153 cards

Supreme Victors is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Platinum series, released in English on August 19, 2009. Its main set has 147 cards, plus 6 secret rares numbered beyond the set (153 in total). It includes 146 Pokémon, 7 Trainer and 0 Energy cards, and is not legal in Standard or Expanded.

Illustrators

32 illustrators worked on Supreme Victors. Most cards: Masakazu Fukuda (13), Kouki Saitou (12), Kagemaru Himeno (11), Atsuko Nishida (10), kawayoo (9), Mitsuhiro Arita (9), Hajime Kusajima (8), Kanako Eo (6).
